NEA Jazz Master Jack DeJohnette is one of the most influential drummers in jazz history. He also has made significant contributions as a pianist, composer, and bandleader.
Jack was interviewed via Zoom on April 7, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Jack DeJohnette with me this morning, from your home. You’re near Woodstock, is that correct?
